tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL CONDITIONS AND TERMS AS PER RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a registered company in India under the Companies Act 1956 or 2013 a Partnership firm under the Partnership Act 1932 or a Proprietary Concern and must have been in business for at least three 3 years FY 2023-24 FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 as of 31-03-2026

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: As on the bid notification date, the Bidder must not be blacklisted or under declaration of ineligibility for corrupt fraudulent, unethical business practices or unsatisfactory performance by the Government of India State Governments or Central or State PSUs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must possess a consolidated positive Net Worth as on the last date of each of the preceding three (3) financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have executed turnkey laboratory upgradation or similar institutional infrastructure works during the last three (3) financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26) for Schools, Colleges, Universities, Government Departments, or PSUs. The scope must encompass: modular laboratory furniture/equipment, ICT/digital teaching aids, electrical & power-backup systems (UPS/DG sets), safety and security systems, and associated integration/commissioning

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/OEM must hold valid certifications for ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2015.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder or OEM must possess a valid All India Occupational Therapists Association AIOTA Certificate for ergonomic design and performance

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/OEM must hold a valid GreenPro Certificate (issued by CII-IGBC) for the offered products (Furniture Items), confirming adherence to environmental sustainability and lifecycle standards

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: General Bidders: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of Rs 300 Crore across the last three (3) financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26) Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) for manufacturing of laboratory furniture: Minimum Averagen Annual Turnover of Rs150 Crore across the last two (2) financial years (FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have successfully executed similar project(s) in any one of the last three (3) financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, or FY 2025-26) meeting the following aggregate value thresholds: General Bidders: Minimum aggregate value of Rs 120 Crore.Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) for manufacturing of laboratory furniture: Minimum aggregate value of Rs 60 Crore.Qualifying works must pertain to laboratory furniture, ICT/teaching aids, electrical/power systems, safety/security equipment, or composite laboratory infrastructure for Government Bodies or PSUs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP
